topic: Remove a rust stain from clothing
core_question: How do I get a rust stain out of clothing? (secondary: What do I do if I miss a connecting flight?)
answer_summary: Sprinkle salt on the stain, squeeze lemon juice over it, let it sit in direct sunlight for an hour, then rinse and launder, avoiding chlorine bleach which sets rust.; after the topic shift: Head straight to the airline's transfer or customer service desk (or call/use their app) to get automatically rebooked on the next available flight, which airlines typically do at no extra charge if the connection was on the same ticket.
persona: anxious and rambling; writing in full careful sentences
